concept.description: Labels methods and types carrying @PreAuthorize / @PostAuthorize / @Secured / @RolesAllowed as :Authorized (authExpr = expression).
concept.cypher: MATCH (x)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(at:Type) WHERE (x:Method OR x:Type) AND at.fqn IN ['org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize', 'org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PostAuthorize', 'org.springframework.security.access.annotation.Secured', 'jakarta.annotation.security.RolesAllowed', 'javax.annotation.security.RolesAllowed'] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(v:Value {name: 'value'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:CONTAINS]->(e:Value) WITH x, v, head(collect(DISTINCT e.value)) AS firstItem SET x:Authorized, x.authExpr = coalesce(v.value, firstItem) RETURN count(DISTINCT x) AS Authorized

constraint.description: Validating redirect targets / origins with String#startsWith is bypassable (https://trusted.com.evil.com): parse the URI and compare host and scheme.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(st:Type {fqn: 'java.lang.String'}) WHERE NOT t:Test AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'startsWith' AND toLower(m.name) =~ '.*(redirect|whitelist|origin).*' RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'String#startsWith used for URL validation' AS Detail
